observations: For the 2026-09-21 US session, Reuters reported S&P 500 +1.49%, Nasdaq +2.26%, and PHLX Semiconductor Index +4.3%, with communications and technology among leaders.

C.engine: Japan/Korea indices and FX, Asian opening
observations: Japan cash equities were closed for an extended holiday, so no fresh Nikkei cash close existed for 2026-09-22.
South Korea and broader Asian technology shares were firmer; AP reported KOSPI +0.2% and Reuters described tech-led gains across Asia.
Reuters reported USD/JPY near 157.7 with the yen weaker as expectations for rapid BOJ tightening faded.
During the 2026-09-22 Hong Kong session Reuters reported HSI +0.3% and HSTECH +0.6%; another Reuters-sourced market snapshot had HSI +0.4%, HSTECH +1.0% and CSI300 +0.5% at midday.
Offshore yuan was near a multi-year high around 6.6946 per US dollar on 2026-09-21 after the PBOC allowed a stronger fixing path.
A same-session HIBOR observation and a fully verified post-close HSI/HSTECH/CSI300/CNH bundle were not all available in the free evidence set.
Brent rebounded above $100 to about $101.67 on 2026-09-22 and was still roughly 12% higher for September, while physical crude stress remained elevated.
Gold fell as higher-for-longer rate expectations strengthened; Reuters linked oil and commodity pressure to renewed inflation and rate-hike risk.
This combination is inflationary/rate-tightening pressure rather than clean growth-only risk-on.

First-party/company-specific market evidence was constructive in AI-linked Hong Kong activity, including Alibaba's expanded AI/chip roadmap and Ligent's strong IPO debut.
A broad, verified current-session personal/social-sentiment sample was not available and was not inferred from price action.

Only older weekly/through-2026-09-18 Southbound summaries were available from secondary research; these are not a substitute for current-session flow evidence.

qualitative_read.directional_summary: Risk appetite was constructive in US and Asian technology/AI equities, but the macro tape remained materially conflicted by oil above $100, near-5% US 10Y yields and renewed tightening expectations.
qualitative_read.reason_for_no_regime: The accepted contract states that reference exposure bands must not be applied from incomplete engines. Engines A, B, C, D, F and especially G retain material same-session evidence gaps, so a bounded formal regime/cap is not authorized.
